seo.metaDescription: Explore enterprise work at Linkfields, our ways of working, employer story and how to ask the recruitment team about current roles and application guidance.
seo.keywords: Linkfields careers, recruitment, enterprise technology, YES programme

sections.title: Careers at Linkfields
sections.subtitle: Build your next chapter through enterprise work across technology, engineering, data, security and advisory.

sections.heading: What working here looks like
sections.body: Our work spans Digital Transformation, Intelligent Enterprise Platforms, Data & AI, Cyber Security and Talent Advisory & GCC. It brings together enterprise services, proprietary software and reusable delivery IP, from application engineering to governed data and security.
sections.secondaryHeading: A role shaped by the work
sections.secondaryBody: Look for the team, project type and responsibilities that match your experience. Discuss collaboration, development opportunities and location-specific working arrangements with recruitment rather than assuming one policy applies to every role. [Explore our capabilities](/services).

sections.heading: How we *work together*

items.title: Ownership
items.description: Make commitments clear, raise risks early and take responsibility for your work.

items.title: Respect
items.description: Listen to different perspectives and challenge ideas constructively.

items.title: Craftsmanship
items.description: Review the detail, test what you build and leave useful documentation for the next person.

items.title: Collaboration
items.description: Share context, ask questions and learn through feedback from the people doing the work.

sections.description: These behaviours connect with the company values on About Linkfields.

sections.heading: Work experience and *employer recognition*

items.title: Great Place To Work® recognition (2023–24)
items.description: Hiring and fostering talent from diverse backgrounds is part of our employer story. Our India team was Great Place To Work® Certified for September 2023 to September 2024.
items.footText: Certification period September 2023 – September 2024 (India); not a current certification.

items.title: YES programme participation
items.description: The Youth Employment Service initiative focuses on meaningful work experience for unemployed young people. Our employer story includes participation in this initiative.

logo.alt: Youth Employment Service membership image from the Linkfields employer story

items.footText: Ask the recruitment team about current programme opportunities and eligibility.

sections.description: Employer recognition and programme participation are separate from current vacancy availability.

sections.heading: Current opportunities and how to apply
sections.body: For current role availability and application guidance, email [careers@linkfields.com](mailto:careers@linkfields.com). Ask for the role description, hiring location, work model and application destination before sending a full application. This page does not publish a live vacancy list.
sections.secondaryBody: Introduce your area of expertise and the kind of role you are seeking. The recruitment team can explain screening, interviews, any role-specific assessment and next steps, along with candidate-data handling and accessibility arrangements. Do not send identity documents or sensitive personal information in an initial enquiry.
